capabilities.name: Colour conversion, transfer functions, halftones, and scan conversion

decision.rationale: This is distinct from colour-space parsing: it defines the final rendered result.

capabilities.notes: Each renderer/oracle contract must state which device and colour-management assumptions it makes.

knownLimitations: Each renderer/oracle contract must state which device and colour-management assumptions it makes.
explicitEvidenceGaps: No paired positive and negative/conservation evidence is claimed; do not promote this capability to implemented-and-proven.

capabilities.name: Version declarations, compatibility, implementation limits, and linearized files

decision.rationale: Excise must read common historic files safely even when it does not write every legacy feature.

capabilities.notes: Track PDF 1.0 through 1.7 intake separately from PDF 2.0 output; linearization is a performance/streaming feature, not a visual feature.

knownLimitations: Track PDF 1.0 through 1.7 intake separately from PDF 2.0 output; linearization is a performance/streaming feature, not a visual feature.
explicitEvidenceGaps: No paired positive and negative/conservation evidence is claimed; do not promote this capability to implemented-and-proven.

capabilities.name: PDF 2.0 deprecated-feature intake and no-new-output policy

decision.rationale: Existing PDFs may use deprecated 1.7 facilities; readers preserve or safely ignore them, while writers must not add them to new PDF 2.0 output.

capabilities.notes: Initial inventory: legacy encryption algorithms, XFA/NeedsRendering, Movie/Sound/TrapNet and actions, Info, ProcSet, OS-specific files and Launch additions, names for XObjects/fonts, blend-mode arrays, alternate presentations, OPI, CharSet/CIDSet, prepress viewer preferences, NeedAppearances, legacy signature handlers, FDF encryption, MarkInfo Suspects, and UR signatures.
